decode: flag has one character per grid cell, row-major, row 0 = north (same as the PNG), cell index = row * nlon + col: '-' = masked or no data, '1' = significant after FDR, '0' = not significant. slope and p list only the non-'-' cells, in the same order (the k-th non-'-' character of flag is slope[k], p[k]). p = raw Hamed-Rao Mann-Kendall p-value (2 significant figures); slope 3 significant figures.
